details: Callback ordering is correct: before_update runs pre-save, after_commit callbacks run post-transaction-commit. No interference possible between phases.

Dirty-tracking methods are correct for their context: broadcast_status_change uses status_changed? (pre-save dirty state), after_commit callbacks use saved_change_to_status? (post-save changes). The spec at line 35 says saved_change_to_status? for the before_update guard, which would be wrong at runtime (it returns false before the save), but the implementation correctly uses status_changed? instead. This is a spec text inaccuracy, not a code bug.

The rescue StandardError => e block in broadcast_status_change is intentionally safe: it prevents a failed websocket broadcast from aborting the status update. This matches the Organization model analog (app/models/organization.rb:966-968) which uses the identical pattern in its before_update callback.
update_summary_status_record correctly includes updated_at: Time.current on line 74.

Enum coverage is complete: 10 enum values total. BROADCAST_STATUSES has 7 (textract_processing, extracting, summarizing, scoring, integrating, succeeded, failed). Skip list has 3 (pending, awaiting_job_criteria, retrying). 7 + 3 = 10. No uncovered statuses.
